ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Fraud in Minnesota Human Services
ideas.description: Investigation into the financial trail of fraud in Minnesota human services, including the amount of money lost and the individuals and organizations involved.
questions: How much money has been lost to fraud in Minnesota human services?
Who are the individuals and organizations involved in the fraud?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can uncover the extent of the fraud and identify the individuals and organizations involved. This investigation has the potential to reveal a large-scale scheme and bring those responsible to justice.
